original_cases.name: main
original_cases.reason: Pure fill/stroke resolution behavior, missing href errors, inverse/bounds, linear/radial sampling, stops, cache sharing, and opacity inputs are covered by resolver/sampler tests. Frozen decode result-count, raster alpha/compositing, overlap and rendered pixels require the real later DECODE/RENDER adapter and are not claimed.

original_cases.name: exact_gradient_check
original_cases.reason: The frozen x=0/8/15 channel tuples are byte-for-byte asserted in exact_gradient_sample_matches_frozen_pixel_channel_oracle. The second layered alpha/compositor predicate requires actual render_rgba integration.

original_cases.name: paint_edge_span_check
original_cases.reason: edge_span_preserves_empty_and_invalid_range_contract ports empty, formed, valid-one-edge, and invalid-overflow behavior.

original_cases.name: cached_gradient_scan_check
original_cases.reason: cached_gradient_scan_original_scale_and_css_stop_cascade retains all 4,096 comment tokens and 512 fill references, asserts one two-stop cached template and the original token-visit bound. Full decoder shape count and rendered document scan await the real DECODE adapter.

original_cases.name: gradient_checks
original_cases.reason: Focused tests cover linear channels, black defaults, radial center math, CSS stops/currentColor, user-space/object-box values, transforms, invalid bounds, and alpha-adjusted stop bytes. Raster alpha compositing and all mixed render predicates remain for later integration.

original_cases.name: test_gradient_full_tile_radial_interior_uses_center_sample
original_cases.reason: radial_defaults_and_pattern_classification_explicit checks center sampling and radial equations directly. Full-tile scan conversion/subsample output and reference CLI comparison need the later real renderer.

later_integration_proofs: real DECODE adapter invokes resolve_fill and appends fill/stroke atomically through SceneBuilder
